causes.L6: The store is not in the export list (no location under SAP), so none of its legacy transactions can be exported. They are stuck from the first moment until master data adds it.
causes.L7: The store has no export counter row, so the legacy uploader fails on it every cycle. Its legacy transactions are stuck from the first moment until the counters are copied.
